query: My Nexa X1 screen inputs are delayed and the touch responsiveness is laggy, causing a noticeable delay when I try to interact with the phone.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touch Responsiveness Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Touch screen fix

actions.description: It will prevent accidental palm touches from interfering with intentional inputs

steps: Toggle on Palm touch to turn off screen.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables palm touch to turn off screen via device Settings on the device.
actionableDeeplink.message: Enable palm touch to turn off screen

validationDeeplink.key: Palm touch to turn off screen

actions.actionName: Adjust Motion Smoothness for Touch Accuracy
actions.description: It will reconfigure the display refresh rate to improve touch input sampling speed

steps: Select Adaptive to allow the screen to dynamically optimise for touch input.

actionableDeeplink.description: Updates the motion smoothness (refresh rate) to a specified value via device Settings.

actions.description: It will secure your personal files before a factory reset to fix persistent touch issues

steps: Tap Back up data and perform a full backup.
After backup, proceed to Settings > General management > Reset > Factory data reset.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables data backup to TechCorp Cloud via device Settings on the device.
